name: WALKFLOW Demo — Real Estate: Error Handling & Owner Notification

parameters.content:
PREPARED, NOT TESTED. Set this as the Error Workflow (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow) on workflows 01, 02 and 03 so any node failure there triggers this one automatically, instead of silently failing.

This workflow: (1) marks the originating job as 'failed' in demo_real_estate_jobs with a real error code/message so the website's poll can show a genuine retry state — never a fake success, and (2) optionally notifies Joshua (email node, disabled by default — enable and configure a credential once a real notification address is agreed). It never surfaces internal error detail to the visitor; the website only ever sees the codes defined in src/lib/real-estate-demo/contract.ts (DemoErrorCode).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { status: "failed", error_code: "upstream_unavailable", error_message: $json.execution.data.resultData.error.message, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }}

nodes.name: Notify Joshua (disabled by default)
nodes.notes: Disabled until a real notification address and email credential are agreed and configured — see .env.example.
